courses.overview: 由環腔共振、通道格點與熱鎖定延伸到不同工法，保留物理關係並重新界定系統邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Extend ring resonances, channel grids and thermal locking to related methods while retaining physical relationships and redefining system boundaries.

related.title: 波分多工陣列波導光柵
related.why: 兩課共用通道格點與串擾矩陣。
related.whyEn: Both share channel grids and crosstalk matrices.
related.transfer: 兩課共用通道格點與串擾矩陣。
related.transferEn: Both share channel grids and crosstalk matrices.
related.difference: 環有週期共振與局部熱調；AWG 由多臂相位共同成像。
related.differenceEn: Rings have periodic resonances and local tuning; AWGs image through collective arm phases.
practice: 比較溫度梯度對兩種通帶形狀的影響。

標出交接時不能直接沿用的材料參數或控制條件。
practiceEn: Compare temperature-gradient effects on both passbands.
Choose one falsifying measurement in each course.
Identify material parameters or control conditions that cannot be transferred unchanged.

courses.summary: 微環波分多工濾波器以環腔共振、通道格點與熱鎖定連結元件物理與系統驗證。此代表地點用於認識研究與封裝供應鏈；課程由多個公開來源交叉編寫。
courses.summaryEn: Microring wavelength-multiplexing filters links device physics and system validation through ring resonances, channel grids and thermal locking. This representative location illustrates the research and packaging ecosystem; the curriculum draws on several public sources.
courses.connection: 以環腔共振、通道格點與熱鎖定比較相關工法；重新核對材料、波段、控制拓撲與驗收門檻。
courses.connectionEn: Compare related methods through ring resonances, channel grids and thermal locking, rechecking materials, wavelength, control topology and acceptance limits.

history.title: imec 多通道濾波器展示
history.text: imec 的「32 通道矽光子波分多工濾波器」提供可追溯的發展案例。它支援本課的原理與設計問題；課程算例另行設定，並不冒充該研究的性能。研究事件與地圖的封裝代表據點分開標示，不主張兩者發生在同一地點。
history.textEn: imec: 32-channel silicon-photonic wavelength filter provides a traceable development example. It informs the principles and design questions; course calculations use separate assumptions and do not claim that study's performance. The research event and the representative packaging location are distinct and are not claimed to share a site.

history.title: 從單元件指標到可測試系統
history.titleEn: From component metrics to testable systems
history.text: 本課把環腔共振、通道格點與熱鎖定放在材料、介面及封裝的連續證據鏈中。下列原始研究與機構資料呈現不同發展路線；此欄是教學脈絡，並非宣稱此地的發明年表。
history.textEn: This course puts ring resonances, channel grids and thermal locking within a continuous evidence chain of materials, interfaces and packaging. The primary studies and institutional records show different development routes; this is learning context, not a claimed invention timeline for this location.
